title: Documentary project with secret dating evidence
summary: Matt tells of Documentary project with secret dating evidence, about 2024 at Turkey, Peru, Bolivia, Minorca, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I am part of a very significant documentary that I'm leading

plain: A man named Matt, speaking on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2024 in an episode about a supposed great event around 12,000 BC, says he is leading a very significant documentary. He says it covers ancient sites in Turkey, Peru, Bolivia and the Spanish island of Minorca, and holds evidence about their age that has not yet been made public, evidence that if true would push these sites much further back in time than usually thought.
